advisor_algorithm.B_semantics: maximum selected candidate definitions; physical object count is separate
advisor_algorithm.partial_round_policy: discard incomplete round and retain last committed incumbent

system_freeze.change_policy: Any production semantic change to the advisor or either PostgreSQL build requires a new system freeze; historical v1 artifacts retain their v1 provenance.

v1_compatibility.historical_artifact_rule: Existing RQ1 and Forest10 RQ4 artifacts retain their embedded system-freeze-v1 provenance and are not retroactively reassigned to v2.

validation_scope.singleton_equivalence_claim: Power7 and Forest10 confirmatory evidence only; not exhaustive cross-dataset validation
